subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly describes the nature of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Very rigid and difficult to amend

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Neither rigid nor flexible**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Constitution** is described as "neither rigid nor flexible" because it strikes a balance between the two extremes.
 
• The process of **amendment** in the Indian Constitution is designed to be both adaptable and protective of its fundamental structure.
